title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — Test & Commission variant
description: Variant for Test & Commissioning (T&C) inspections — water-tightness, plumbing pressure, electrical, ACMV balancing, lift commissioning, fire-system functional tests. Defects in this frame are pass/fail outcomes against a documented test, with measured values and witnessed-by context for contractual record.

test_type.description: Specific T&C test being performed. Drives the test-procedure reference and acceptance criteria. Required.

test_outcome.description: Pass/fail verdict for the test. Empty if the test is in progress.

measured_value.description: Test reading + unit (e.g. '0.5 MPa', '2.0 m³/s', '1500 lux'). Free text — units depend on test_type.

witnessed_by.description: Authority / consultant / client representative who witnessed the test. Required for contractual T&C; empty for in-progress dry runs.
